book.name: 2 Tisalunika
book.title: Ka Igkaruwa no Sulat ni Pablo to mgo Taga Tisalunika

content: Ka Buyu ni Pablo Oyow Og-ampuan Sikandin

Soini naan do mgo sulod ka ignangon noy kaniu. Ampui koy oyow magaan on ogpakatangkap ka kagi to Lagboy no Igbuyag ta woy to oyow ogkabantug to mgo otow ka soini no nangnangonon unawa to nohimu on dio to kaniu.
Woy ogbuyu koy to oyow ogkabantayan koy rin oyow kono koy ogpakasagad to mgo otow no mangungulug su duon mgo otow no waro nigtuu ki Hisus.
Di ogkasaligan tanow si Hisus no ian Lagboy no Igbuyag ta to songo ogbantayan kow rin woy ogpanokalnokal to goinawa ta oyow kono kow ogkaroog ni Satanas.
Ligkat to Lagboy no Igbuyag ta, og-iman-iman koy tongod kaniu to ogpaagad-agad kow kuntoon woy to ogparagas kow no ogpaagad-agad to innangon noy kaniu.

Ogbuyu koy to Lagboy no Igbuyag ta no si Hisu Kristu to oyow ogkasabutan now on ian ka dakol no goinawa to Magboboot kaniu woy to oyow ogkaaguanta now ka mgo igkabaybayari now no ogligkat to pogbulig ni Hisu Kristu to goinawa now.

Kuntoon, mgo sulod, su duon katondanan noy no ogligkat to ngaran to Lagboy no Igbuyag ta no si Hisu Kristu, duon igsapad noy kaniu to kono kow on ogdumaruma to mgo otow no ogtuu di kono ogtalabau no kono og-unug to batasan no in-anad noy kaniu.
Ian su nataga kow to og-awoson now no og-unug kow to kanami no batasan no wa koy mapogul no ogtalabau no dio koy pad to kaniu.
Tibo no nakoon noy nabayaran noy on ian; waro koy nigsalig kaniu. Di nigpoomot koy nigtalabau to maallow woy ko marusilom oyow kono koy ogpakasasow to agad hontow kaniu to pog-ugpo noy.
Agad to duon katondanan noy no litos poron ko nigbuyu koy pa poron kaniu to ogkakoon noy, wa koy nig-awos. Dokad di to nigtalabau koy atag to oyow ogkapanag-ilingan now ka batasan noy.
Ko dio koy to kaniu, insapad noy kaniu to soini: ko duon otow no kono ogtalabau, kono now pakoona.
Ian noy innangon kaniu to soini su duon kun dio to kaniu no mgo otow no pogulon. Kono kun ogtalabau, di ogtalantanon dan ka duma ran to kandan no talabau.

Nò, su duon katondanan noy ligkat to ngaran to Lagboy no Igbuyag ta no si Hisu Kristu, ogbuyuon noy woy ogsuguon noy to oyow, ka sikan no mgo otow, ogtalabau no kono ogpansasowsasow oyow ogpakatood sikandan no oghimu to kandan no pog-ugpo.
Di sikaniu, atag, mgo sulod, kono kow ogpapopogul no oghimu to maroyow.
Di ko duon otow no kono ogpaagad-agad to innangon noy to soini no sulat, indani now no kono kow ogdumaruma kandin oyow ogmasakit so goinawa rin to batasan din.
Di kono now maroota ka goinawa now kandin di udlingi now no ogkounawa to pog-udling now to hari now.
Ka Igtuguntugun ni Pablo

Ka Lagboy no Igbuyag ta ka ogligkatan to maawang no goinawa ta, no ogbuyu koy to oyow, agad nokoy ka ogkabayaan now, ungod kow rin ogbogayan to sikan no maawang no goinawa now, woy to oyow layun kow rin ogdumaan.
Sikanak ian no si Pablo ka lagboy ogsulat to soini no ignangon ku to ogdoromdomon ku sikaniu. No to tibo no sulat ku, sikan ian ka batasan ku to ogsulat.
Ogbuyu a to oyow ogkohoy-uan kow tibo to Lagboy no Igbuyag ta no si Hisu Kristu.
